t: Moody’s affirms Coop Pank’s ratings and positive outlook
s: November 27, 2025 - The rating agency Moody’s Ratings affirmed Coop Pank’s Credit rating at current level with positive outlook. Long- and short-term deposit rating remained on the level of Baa2 and rating outlook remained positive.
